rows.grounds: instrumental plural of vibhakta (divided, separated); qualifies mantra+varṇaiś
compound mantra+varṇa in instrumental plural; syllables/letters of the mantra
compound ṣaḍ+aṅga (six limbs) in genitive plural; refers to the six ancillary parts
action noun from kḷp (to fashion, arrange); denotes ritual construction or assignment

items.question: By what components is the ritual arrangement of mantra syllables and six limbs to be fashioned?
premises: Mantra syllables are employed in a divided form.
The six limbs constitute a component of the arrangement.
A ritual arrangement is to be fashioned from these components.
items.inference: The arrangement is fashioned using divided mantra syllables together with the six limbs.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic scope of the two ca particles in relation to the preceding ritual instructions is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: The arrangement is to be made with the divided mantra syllables and with those of the six limbs.
